task: Write a welcoming invitation of about 55–85 words for a fictional neighbourhood board-game evening. Address people who may prefer watching before joining. Explain the actual arrangements without pressuring readers to speak, compete, or make friends, and without presenting the event as a therapeutic service.

facts.text: The evening takes place on Friday from 5–7 p.m. in the Lantern Room.
Attendance is free and no advance booking is needed.
The available games are cooperative rather than competitive.
Visitors may watch without playing or speaking.
A host can explain a game's rules on request.

forbidden_additions: Mandatory introductions, participation, registration, or competition.
A promise that every visitor will feel comfortable or make friends.
Therapeutic benefits or unprovided accessibility guarantees.
preserve: Watching as a legitimate way to attend.
A low-pressure invitation grounded in concrete arrangements.
